review.tagline: Express TypeScript CRUD API template with an LLM module generator
review.summary: Express and TypeScript REST API with vertical-slice modules, Zod validation, InversifyJS DI, Knex transactions, ioredis caching, winston trace IDs, node-cron, S3 uploads and Supertest e2e tests, run via docker compose on port 8080. The llm-codegen folder runs three LLM micro-agents (Developer, Troubleshooter, TestsFixer) that generate a new CRUD module, migration, seeds and passing tests from a text description.
review.audience: Node teams wanting LLM-generated CRUD modules on a clean base
strengths: Codegen loop compiles and runs e2e tests until they pass
Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek and OpenRouter keys for generation
JWT auth routes, Redis cache and cron already in the base API
Tests run in Docker or against local SQLite
weaknesses: AI is a dev-time generator; the API itself has no AI features
Node badge pins v14 to v20; check against current LTS
Generated code still needs manual review and integration
needs: Needs PostgreSQL or SQLite, Redis, AWS S3 (uploads), LLM API key for codegen
